title: FDs SkyDungeons LowPoly
description: Resource pack that simplifies dungeons textures and highlight possibly needed textures.
body:
**LOWPOLY HYPIXEL SKYBLOCK CATACOMBS
Clearer, more straight forward catacombs resource pack**

**THIS RESOURCE PACK IS RECOMMENDED TO HIGHER LVL CATACOMBS PLAYERS**

_It can be misleading for a person not knowing the area. This resource pack is created for straight forward running with highlighted stuff, it is not recommended to learn dungeoneering with this resourcepack_

![Example of low poly](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e34e33ceb95fea1ad28a9a4b74334965b007643f_0.webp)

**This resourcepack is a part of FDs SkyBlock TWEAKS**
Collection of resource packs containing small to medium modifications to the textures, that players can combine into their needs.
